answer.rationale: P99 latency is 5x target on write path in primary region during peak settlement traffic. The security patch cannot be rolled back per compliance. Regional failover (memory_b2) restored latency in minutes during March degradation with clean traffic shift. This is the only tool that doesn't require code reversion or reject the security constraint. Failover is a proven pattern here and buys time for investigation while preserving the mandatory patch and all customer writes during peak settlement. Read replica routing (memory_b5) helps dashboard queries but does not address write path latency in primary. Adding capacity takes time we don't have. Circuit breakers don't solve primary region saturation.
